responsibility: Implements loop array-prefetch insertion on tree SSA. For each loop it gathers data references, analyzes spatial/temporal reuse and dependence distance, estimates profitable prefetch lead time and unroll factors from loop size, trip count, and target cache/prefetch parameters, chooses which references to prefetch within simultaneous-prefetch limits, optionally unrolls the loop to satisfy scheduling constraints, and finally emits __builtin_prefetch operations and nontemporal-store markings.
